result.title: ContactCut: A Partition-Aware Contact Selection Framework for False-Merge Correction in Connectomics
result.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to the IEEE International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI) 2027
result.summary: Localized false-merge correction in connectomics requires converting an identified error into an executable native 3D partition. Still, neither intermediate correction predictions nor seeded graph solvers alone determine which native source-sink constraints should define that partition. We formulate this problem as a 3D-native partition-aware contact selection problem: selecting candidate contacts based on the complete partitions they induce. Our solution comprises two components: ContactCut (CC)-Auto, which uses learned single-contact selection, and ContactCut (CC)-Search, which enables bounded paired-contact search, generates compact alternatives, and applies learned panel ranking. On historical two-way false-merge corrections from MICrONS and FlyWire, CC-Auto improves failure-aware 3D partition (FA-3D Part.) mIoU by 5.9 and 3.4 points over the strongest graph-based controls and by 12.5 and 10.0 points over the best learned baselines. A MICrONS-trained ranker transfers to FlyWire with negligible degradation. CC-Search expands oracle reachability and prioritizes near-oracle alternatives. The code is available at https://github.com/bentake/ContactCut.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把连接组学中的局部误合并纠正表述为「依据候选接触所诱导的完整 3D 分区来做选择」的问题，提出 CC-Auto（学习式单接触选择）与 CC-Search（有界成对接触搜索生成紧凑备选并做学习式面板排序），在 MICrONS 与 FlyWire 的纠正数据上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 按候选所诱导的下游结果而非局部打分来筛选，并用学习排序器在有限备选面板中比较方案，可能为 LVR 中多条 latent 假设与视觉证据的筛选和验证提供方法线索，可供核查其迁移性。
